note: Lambda suits a sub-second webhook; Spot suits the checkpointed 40-minute render (using-spot-instances: cost-effective if work can be interrupted). Standard Lambda is capped at 15 minutes (gettingstarted-limits), and Spot is not for fault-intolerant payment work (spot-best-practices).
Lambda is capped at 15 minutes so a 40-minute conversion cannot run there; a Fargate task per conversion needs no servers or cluster (AWS_Fargate overview).
